title: IDKMesh Human Decision Request v0.1
description: Transport request body for recording an immutable Human Decision Record. The caller supplies only the explicit decision, rationale, selected attempt and exact evidence-report binding. Authenticated principal identity, decision_id, decided_at and authority are trusted server/domain outputs and cannot be supplied by this request. Idempotency-Key is an HTTP header governed by API_CONVENTIONS_V0_1 section 12, not a body field. This contract does not itself execute integration, Git push or merge.
